verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents API coverage across most of its product surface: connected accounts, transfers, refunds, subscriptions, invoicing, payment links, multi-currency pricing and webhooks. It also ships an official CLI and an AgentOS MCP server that read and write production resources. However, nothing documents UI–API parity: the CLI covers only 'a broad slice' of the API, the MCP blocks money-out actions by default, and webhook re-delivery is described as a web-app feature. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement or coverage matrix, evidence that UI-only operations (e.g. webhook re-delivery, dispute handling) are exposed via API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
